meet.landingBody: Private calls on Zentico's own servers. Start a meeting and share the link with anyone in your workspace.
meet.invalidCode: That doesn't look like a meeting code. Codes look like abc-defg-hij.
meet.notConfiguredHint: Ask your administrator to connect a LiveKit server (LIVEKIT_URL, LIVEKIT_API_KEY and LIVEKIT_API_SECRET).
meet.connectFailed: We couldn't connect to the meeting server. Check your connection and try again.
meet.permissionDenied: Camera or microphone access is blocked. Allow it from the address bar and reload — you can still join without them.
meet.noDevices: No camera or microphone found. You can still join and use chat.
meet.noCamera: No camera found. You can join with audio only.
meet.noMic: No microphone found. Others won't be able to hear you.
meet.deviceBusy: Your camera or microphone is in use by another app.
meet.insecureContext: Camera and microphone need a secure (HTTPS) connection.
meet.audioBlocked: Your browser paused the call audio.
meet.switchCall: Leave it and join this one
meet.chatUnread: Chat, {count, plural, one {# new message} other {# new messages}}
meet.chatEmpty: Messages are only visible to people in the call and disappear when it ends.
meet.leftDuplicate: You joined this meeting from another tab or device
meet.leftLost: You were disconnected from the meeting
meet.recNoticeSelf: Everyone in this call is notified. Each person's audio is recorded and transcribed on Zentico's servers.
meet.recNotice: {name} is recording this call. Your audio is recorded and transcribed on Zentico's servers.
meet.recStartedSelf: Recording started. Everyone in the call has been notified.
meet.rec_busy: Someone else is already recording this call
meet.rec_startFailed: Couldn't start the recording. Try again.
meet.rec_uploadFailed: Recording stopped: audio couldn't be uploaded
meet.rec_tooLarge: Recording stopped: it reached the size limit
meet.rec_videoFailed: Video recording couldn't start. Recording audio for the transcript only.
meet.recModeVideoHint: Also records the call's video to your Drive
meet.recNoticeSelfVideo: Everyone in this call is notified. The call's video and each person's audio are recorded on Zentico's servers.
meet.recNoticeVideo: {name} is recording this call on video. Your video and audio are recorded on Zentico's servers.
meet.recDeleteConfirm: Delete this recording and its audio for everyone? A copy already saved to Drive is kept.
meet.recInProgress: This meeting is still being recorded.
meet.recProcessing: Transcribing… This page updates by itself.
meet.recErrNotConfigured: Transcription isn't configured on this server. The audio is saved; retry once an administrator sets up the Whisper service.
meet.recErrTranscription: Transcription failed. The audio is saved, so you can retry.
meet.recErrDriveSession: The transcript is ready, but it couldn't be saved to Drive because the session expired. Retry to save it.
meet.recErrDrive: The transcript is ready, but it couldn't be saved to Drive. Retry to save it.
meet.recNoSpeech: No speech was detected in this recording.
meet.recVideo_recording: The call's video is being recorded.
meet.recVideo_processing: Processing the video… It will be saved to Drive. This page updates by itself.
meet.recVideo_retrying: The video couldn't be saved to Drive yet. Trying again automatically.
meet.recVideo_ready: The video is saved in the Drive of {name}.
meet.recVideoErr_drive_session_expired: The video is ready, but it couldn't be saved to Drive because the session expired. Retry to save it.
meet.recVideoErr_drive_failed: The video is ready, but it couldn't be saved to Drive. Retry to save it.
meet.recVideoErr_drive_too_large: The video is too large for Drive.
meet.claudeTalkTooShort: Hold the button (or C) while you speak
meet.claudeMicFailed: Couldn't use your microphone to talk to {agent}
meet.claudeListenHint: Everyone's audio in the call is transcribed in 15-second pieces so your {agent} knows what was said when you ask it something. Everyone in the call sees a notice while it's on. The audio is deleted after transcription; the text is kept for an hour and only your {agent} uses it.
meet.claudeListeningSelf: Your {agent} is listening to the meeting
meet.claudeListeningBy: {name}’s assistant is listening to the meeting
meet.claudeListenStartedBy: {name}’s assistant is now listening to the meeting
meet.claudeLocalSttHint: Your graphics card turns speech into text, so no audio is sent to the server and answers come faster. The first time, the speech model (up to 1.6 GB) is downloaded once and kept by your browser.
meet.claudeLocalSttFailed: Local transcription isn't working on this device, so the server is used.
meet.claudeLocalSttUnsupported: This device's GPU can't transcribe locally, so speech is transcribed on the server.
meet.claudeNeedToken: You need a read + write access token to use {agent} commands.
meet.claudeNotConfigured: Speech recognition isn't configured on this server.
meet.claudeUnsupported: This browser can't capture audio for {agent}.
meet.claudeBridgeOff: Your agent bridge isn't running, so commands will wait.
meet.claudeEmpty: Hold the button (or the C key) and say “send Ana a summary of this call”, or type a request below.
meet.claudeShareHint: Post this result in the meeting's chat thread
meet.claudeShareInCallHint: Send this result to the call chat
meet.claudePrivate: Only you see your requests and {agent}'s full answers.
meet.claudeSpeakAnswersHint: {agent} says a one-line summary of each answer out loud for everyone. The full answer stays private.
meet.claudeVoiceStopHint: Stop the assistant’s voice for everyone
meet.claudeVoiceMuteHint: Don't play assistants’ spoken replies on this device
meet.claudeConfirmSpoken: {agent} wants to {action}. Approve it on screen, or hold C and say: confirm.
meet.sendInvites: {count, plural, =0 {Send invite} one {Send invite} other {Send # invites}}
meet.invitePlaceholder: Search a name or type an email
meet.inviteHint: People who use Chat get the invite as a direct message; everyone else gets an email from your account. They need to sign in to Zentico to join.
meet.inviteAddToConversation: Also add them to the “{name}” conversation
meet.inviteConversationOk: They were also added to the conversation.
meet.inviteConversationFailed: Couldn’t add them to the conversation.

inviteErrors.failed: Couldn’t send the invites. Try again.
inviteErrors.invalidEmail: One of the email addresses isn’t valid.
inviteErrors.tooMany: You can invite up to 50 people at a time.
inviteErrors.rateLimited: You’ve sent a lot of invites in a row. Wait a few minutes.

meet.inviteChat: Join me in this video call: {link}
meet.inviteChatTitled: Join me in the “{title}” video call: {link}
meet.inviteMailSubject: {name} invited you to a video call
meet.inviteMailSubjectTitled: {name} invited you to a video call: {title}
meet.inviteMailIntro: {name} is inviting you to join a Zentico video call that is happening now.
meet.inviteMailIntroTitled: {name} is inviting you to join the “{title}” Zentico video call that is happening now.
meet.stageOpen: Open the stage (shared whiteboard and notes)
meet.stageFailed: Couldn't update the stage. Try again.
meet.stageSaveHint: Save to Drive (whiteboards and notes), shared with the meeting's people
meet.stageSaved: {count, plural, =0 {Saved to your Drive} one {Saved to your Drive and shared with # person} other {Saved to your Drive and shared with # people}}
meet.stageEmpty: Everyone in the call sees what's here. Draw together, pin notes, or ask {agent} to sketch something.
meet.stageAssistOffer: Let {agent} keep the stage up to date
meet.stageAssistNeedsBridge: Start your agent bridge to use this
meet.stageAssistMine: Your {assistant} is listening and updating the stage
meet.stageAssistBy: {name}’s assistant ({assistant}) is listening and updating the stage
meet.stageAssistChat: {name}’s assistant ({assistant}) is now listening to the meeting and updating the stage. Anyone can pause it.
meet.stageRemoveConfirm: Remove "{title}" from the stage for everyone in the call?
meet.stageNotesConflict: Someone changed these notes while you were editing. This is the newer version; your text is kept below.
meet.stageOpenFromMini: Back to the call, on the stage

calls.switchHint: Hangs up your current call and accepts this one

errors.failed: Couldn't connect the call. Try again.
errors.notConfigured: Meetings aren't configured on this server.
errors.rateLimited: Too many calls in a row. Wait a moment.
